china_race_dynamics.text: When we talk about AI, again, it's here to stay. And we have to put guardrails around it. We have to put legislation around it. And we have to have the key people at the table to have that conversation because we're in an AI race with China. And at this moment, we're a little bit ahead of them. And we don't want China to win the AI race because they can be nefarious and they will punish the United States and other allies with AI.

china_race_dynamics.text: Well, that could be further from the truth. We're working in in a bipartisan fashion, both the House and the Senate, on working to bring common sense legislation revolve evolving around AI and to make sure that there are no dangerous, nefarious AI productions that'll harm the American people and really harm humanity as a whole. And the United States can lead. We can't lose this AI race to China.

china_race_dynamics.text: There are many ways AI can help humanity, from helping small businesses grow to accelerating medical studies.
